visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a silver ladle pouring a spicy red chili sauce into a bowl of Thai boat noodles. The bowl contains broth, noodles, meatballs, and leafy greens. The lighting is bright and indoor. (2) A wide tabletop view displays a feast of Thai dishes, including a whole steamed fish in a metal pot, boat noodles, and a glass of iced orange Thai milk tea. The background shows the restaurant's clean, modern interior. (3) The camera pans across the exterior of 'Feng Thai Wei' restaurant, showing its orange signage and a banner. Several scooters are parked in the urban street setting. (4) Inside the restaurant, the camera shows a neat dining area with white tables and contrasting orange and blue chairs. A middle-aged female owner with short grey-purple hair and a black mask is shown wearing a striped top and purple gloves. (5) A series of rapid close-up shots highlight specific menu items: dark broth boat noodles being tossed, a ladle of dried chili flakes, noodles dripping with sauce, and a whole fish garnished with abundant fresh chilies and cilantro. (6) Further close-ups showcase seafood soup with large shrimp, meaty pork ribs, and 'Krapow' stir-fried pork over rice topped with a fried egg. A hand holds up a glass of iced Thai milk tea. (7) The video concludes with shots of the interior shelves stocked with Thai snacks and a final view of the restaurant's exterior signage with location text overlays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic, up-tempo acoustic guitar track featuring a steady, driving drum beat. A male narrator with a friendly, high-arousal tone introduces the restaurant. The audio quality is clean and professional. (2) A subtle liquid pouring sound is heard as the visuals show sauce being added. The narrator maintains a fast speech rate, detailing the restaurant's history and its new location in Fengshan. (3) The music continues uninterrupted, providing a rhythmic backdrop to the narrator's enthusiastic description of 'Thai boat noodles.' The percussion is crisp, emphasizing the bright, upbeat mood. (4) The narrator's pitch rises when describing the spicy flavors of the seafood soup. There are no significant pauses in the speech. (5) As the visuals shift through various dishes, the narrator lists items like 'volcano ribs' and 'Thai milk tea.' The music maintains its energetic BPM without fading. (6) The video concludes with the narrator giving a cheerful call to action, followed by a brief synthesizer stinger as the track ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional food review for 'Feng Thai Wei' (鳳泰味), a Thai restaurant in Kaohsiung. It aims to inform regular customers about its relocation and attract new ones by showcasing high-quality, appetizing shots of authentic Thai dishes and the comfortable dining environment.
